## Address Verification Procedures  
### Acceptable Address Documents  
**Primary (Preferred):**
- **Utility Bill** — Gas, electricity, water, telephone
- Requirement: Current bill (dated within last 3 months)
- Check: Matches customer name and address
- Acceptable providers: Major suppliers only  
- **Council Tax Document** — Council tax bill or banding notice
- Requirement: Current year
- Check: Matches name and address  
- **Bank Statement** — Another bank's statement
- Requirement: Current (within 3 months)
- Check: Shows name and address
- Limitation: Not accepted as sole evidence if customer has account with us  
**Secondary (If Primary Unavailable):**
- Mortgage statement
- Tenancy agreement (signed, with landlord details)
- Insurance policy (buildings/contents)
- HM Revenue & Customs correspondence
- Electoral register extract

raw_entities.name: Address Verification
raw_entities.description: The process of verifying a customer's address using acceptable documentary evidence. The policy establishes a tiered approach with primary preferred documents (utility bills, council tax documents, bank statements) and secondary alternatives when primary documents are unavailable. All primary documents must be current and match the customer's name and address.
context: Primary (Preferred): Utility Bill — Gas, electricity, water, telephone
Requirement: Current bill (dated within last 3 months)
Check: Matches customer name and address

raw_entities.name: Utility Bill
raw_entities.description: An acceptable primary address verification document covering gas, electricity, water, or telephone bills. Must be current (dated within the last 3 months), match the customer's name and address, and be issued by a major supplier only.
context: Utility Bill — Gas, electricity, water, telephone
Requirement: Current bill (dated within last 3 months)
Check: Matches customer name and address

raw_entities.name: Council Tax Document
raw_entities.description: An acceptable primary address verification document comprising a council tax bill or banding notice. Must be from the current year and match the customer's name and address.
context: Council Tax Document — Council tax bill or banding notice

raw_entities.name: Bank Statement
raw_entities.description: An acceptable primary address verification document from another bank. Must be current (within 3 months) and show the customer's name and address. Cannot be accepted as sole evidence if the customer holds an account with the bank conducting the verification.
context: Limitation: Not accepted as sole evidence if customer has account with us

raw_entities.name: Mortgage Statement
raw_entities.description: An acceptable secondary address verification document used when primary documents are unavailable.

raw_entities.name: Tenancy Agreement
raw_entities.description: An acceptable secondary address verification document. Must be signed and include landlord details.

raw_entities.name: Insurance Policy
raw_entities.description: An acceptable secondary address verification document covering buildings or contents insurance policies.

raw_entities.name: HM Revenue & Customs Correspondence
raw_entities.description: An acceptable secondary address verification document comprising official correspondence from HM Revenue & Customs.

raw_entities.name: Electoral Register Extract
raw_entities.description: An acceptable secondary address verification document comprising an extract from the electoral register.

raw_entities.name: Primary Document Acceptance Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that primary address verification documents (utility bills, council tax documents, or bank statements) must be current and match the customer's name and address exactly.
context: Check: Matches customer name and address
Requirement: Current bill (dated within last 3 months)

raw_entities.name: Bank Statement Sole Evidence Prohibition
raw_entities.description: Prohibits the acceptance of a bank statement as sole evidence of address verification if the customer holds an account with the bank conducting the verification.
context: Limitation: Not accepted as sole evidence if customer has account with us

raw_entities.name: Utility Bill Currency Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires that utility bills used for address verification must be dated within the last 3 months.
context: Requirement: Current bill (dated within last 3 months)

raw_entities.name: Council Tax Document Currency Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires that council tax documents used for address verification must be from the current year.
context: Council Tax Document — Council tax bill or banding notice

raw_entities.name: Bank Statement Currency Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires that bank statements used for address verification must be current (dated within 3 months).

raw_entities.name: Major Supplier Requirement for Utility Bills
raw_entities.description: Mandates that utility bills accepted for address verification must be issued by major suppliers only.

raw_entities.name: Signed Tenancy Agreement with Landlord Details
raw_entities.description: Requires that tenancy agreements used as secondary address verification documents must be signed and include landlord details.
